description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A neurosurgical team needs a 3D-printable model of the cranial bone for pre-operative planning. Complete InVesalius's segmentation and reconstruction workflow: create a bone segmentation mask using an appropriate Hounsfield Unit threshold for cortical bone (the Bone preset is 226–3071 HU), generate a 3D surface mesh from that mask, and export the surface as a binary STL file to /home/ga/Documents/skull_model.stl. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
